images.title: Go up, then across, to read a value
images.purpose: Shows how to read the value at a marked point on a line graph: up from the year to the line, then across to the scale.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One simple line graph with three points, one point marked, and two dashed guide lines.
images.exact_structure: Horizontal axis with 3 evenly spaced ticks labelled 2022, 2023 and 2024. Vertical axis from 1500 to 2500 with 3 ticks at 1500, 2000 and 2500, all labelled. A teal (#0072B2) line joins three small teal circles at about 1950 above 2022, about 2230 above 2023 and about 2250 above 2024. The 2023 point is a larger reddish purple (#CC79A7) circle. A dashed amber (#E69F00) line goes straight up from 2023 on the bottom axis to that point, then a second dashed amber line goes straight left from the point to the vertical axis, ending in a small arrow head with the label about 2230 beside it. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Go up from the year to the line, then across to the scale, and give the value as about a number.
